Subject: Mutual Action Plan: stakeholder orientation & readout — proposed times

Hi Sarah + Tom,

Thanks again for taking time this quarter to evaluate Redwood. As discussed in last week's discovery, we'd like to run a short MAP orientation + evaluation readout to align stakeholders, confirm success criteria, and lock a rough close timeline. Goal: a 45-minute session that leaves us with a shared MAP and owner list.

Proposed agenda (draft attached):
- 5m introductions & scope
- 10m success criteria & acceptance tests
- 15m evaluation plan & timeline (test cases, datasets, infra needs)
- 10m roles, handoffs, and decision gates
- 5m next steps & calendar actions

Two slots that work for our team (PT):
1) Wed 30 Jun, 10:00–10:45 PT
2) Thu 1 Jul, 14:00–14:45 PT

I've attached a draft agenda (draft-map-agenda-v1.pdf) and a preliminary stakeholder roster (stakeholder-roster.csv). If neither slot works, suggest 2 alternatives and we'll do our best to accommodate. Once you confirm, I'll send a calendar invite with Zoom and a short MAP doc for live editing.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
